verdicts.reason: A: the 'PICK YOUR SOUND' eyebrow has dropped to the bottom under the body copy, so it reads in the wrong order. The 'Obsidian One, $349' caption sits under the body text, far from the headphones it names, and the earbuds image is gone, leaving the 'Obsidian Buds' label orphaned. The layout still runs left to right, with the CTA at the right end and the headphones intact. B: the headphones are cropped at the top and bottom edges, and the earbuds are replaced by an empty grey ellipse that leaves dead space on the right. Both price captions, the CTA, the dots and a tiny eyebrow are crammed into one cluttered row of very small text under the headline, so the CTA gets lost and the eyebrow ends up last.
